reviews.title: Unstable and buggy
reviews.comment: I bought this motherboard for a Linux GPU workstation build. I may have gotten a dud, but I had tons of problems with it. The BIOS has some kind of bug that causes constant ACPI errors in  the logs. Upgrading the BIOS to the latest version did not fix the issue. The PCIe gen5 connector seems to be on the  low side so that the graphics card does not fit well in the case. And finally I could not get the graphics card to be stable. Every few minutes I got a ‘GPU dropped off the bus’ error, which required a reboot. I replaced this board with a ASRock Z890 Taichi Lite which has been working without problems so far.
reviews.author: Geert Jansen

reviews.title: Solid board
reviews.comment: So far, it's a rock-solid Windows 11 build. More features than I need. Easy to setup. No issues with the 2.5GB ethernet adapter. I do know how to test network speeds and it's delivering full speeds. Gigabyte software is barebones, but that's great from my point of view.
reviews.author: Bustout

reviews.title: Motherboard Gigabyte Z890
reviews.comment: Motherboard don't work the hard drives showes up in peripheral but will not show up in boot sequence. I have never had this problem with as many computers I have built, can't return it because it's pass the return date.
reviews.author: Annette Smith
